tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send a text message from one of the account's RevDesk phone numbers. Both numbers must be E.164 (+14155550123). Use list_phone_numbers to find a valid 'from' number.

tools.name: place_call
tools.description: Place an outbound phone call from one of the account's RevDesk numbers to a destination. The call is bridged server-side (no audio flows through the AI). Returns a call id for status checks.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List recent calls with status, duration, and cost. Most recent first.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get the current status and details of a single call by id.

tools.name: hangup_call
tools.description: Hang up an in-progress call by id.

tools.name: list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers owned by this account (usable as 'from' numbers).

tools.name: search_available_numbers
tools.description: Search phone numbers available for purchase, by area code or digit pattern.

tools.name: buy_phone_number
tools.description: Purchase a phone number for this account. Provide an exact number from search_available_numbers, or just an area code to auto-pick. Billing applies to the RevDesk account.

tools.name: list_caller_ids
tools.description: List verified caller IDs and their CNAM display names.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current-month usage rollup: calls placed, minutes used, active numbers, spend.
